title.en: Separate wallet approval from payment and repair Polygon reconciliation
title.zh: 分离钱包授权与付款并修复 Polygon 入账

purpose.en: Prevent duplicate or missing wallet confirmations and reliably synchronize successful GreatLoveMeta SmartPay5 payments into membership.
purpose.zh: 防止钱包确认页遗漏或重复，并可靠地把 GreatLoveMeta SmartPay5 成功付款同步为会员权益。

en: Make token approval and payment separate explicit wallet actions and prevent duplicate approval while allowance data propagates.
Keep balance, allowance, contract simulation and gas preflight while letting the connected wallet choose the final gas limit.
Use current Polygon RPC endpoints with independent public-provider failover.
Forward the wallet transaction hash through verification into SmartPay5 receipt reconciliation.
zh: 把代币授权与付款设为独立、明确的钱包操作，并在授权额度传播期间防止重复授权。
保留余额、授权额度、合约模拟与 Gas 预检，同时让已连接钱包决定最终 gas limit。
Polygon 服务端核验使用当前 RPC，并在独立公共服务商之间自动故障转移。
把钱包交易哈希经验证路由传入 SmartPay5 回执核销。

en: GreatLoveMeta membership crypto checkout, SmartPay5 verification and claim routes, wallet transaction submission, and Polygon RPC reads.
zh: 影响 GreatLoveMeta 会员加密结账、SmartPay5 核验与 claim 路由、钱包交易提交及 Polygon RPC 读取。

en: Preserve this site's plans, prices, contracts, tokens, payout settings, member data and Cloudflare resources; reject a changed connected wallet and retain idempotent historical PayerID recovery.
zh: 保留本站套餐、价格、合约、代币、收款设置、会员数据及 Cloudflare 资源；拒绝连接后切换的钱包，并保留幂等的历史 PayerID 恢复。

en: Run the complete build and test suite, zero-warning ESLint, shared policy and architecture contracts, then verify production checkout and Project evidence without sending a real payment.
zh: 运行完整构建与测试、零警告 ESLint、共享策略和架构契约，再验证生产结账页及 Project 证据；不发送真实付款。

en: No real payment is sent and no realtime audio/video test is started.
zh: 未发送真实付款，未启动实时音视频测试。

en: Preserve GreatLoveMeta branding, local membership catalog, login-protected navigation rules, referral identifiers and site-owned SmartPay5 configuration.
zh: 保留 GreatLoveMeta 品牌、本地会员目录、登录受保护导航规则、推荐标识及站点独立 SmartPay5 配置。

rollback.en: Roll back the application release; no data migration is required.
rollback.zh: 回滚应用版本；无需数据迁移。
